summary: Iteration 7 comprehensive backend + web-preview frontend test of the new page editor / cover editor / style-aware generation / design-lock / admin PDF & image upload. BACKEND: 13/13 pytest passed (tests/test_iteration7_page_editor.py). FRONTEND: full acceptance flow verified on 390x844 web preview. Login (9876500999) -> OTP scraped inline (Use XXXXXX) -> Home 'Upload Photos to Begin' (home-create-hero) -> Cover 'Classic Portrait' + cover-continue -> Upload screen used page.expect_file_chooser + upload-pick-button to set 3 JPGs -> upload-generate-button -> Style screen shows heading 'Choose your album style' with exactly style-elegant, style-balanced, style-gallery -> picked Gallery, style-continue-button -> /album/{id}/preview loaded 3D book (preview-next works). Double-tap right page (page.mouse.dblclick at 0.72*w, 0.5*h of BookPreview bounding box) -> /album/{id}/page?index=1 opened, page-editor-save visible, title 'Edit Page 2'. Text tool: page-tool-text -> text-input filled 'Summer in Goa', font-dancing, text-larger, text-bold, text-align, text-color-C56A47 all clickable and visibly change the canvas glyph. Layout tool: page-tool-layout -> layout-2 (Duo) then layout-1 (Single) both changed the canvas. Background tool: page-tool-background swatches change canvas background. Undo (page-editor-undo) + Redo (page-editor-redo) work. Adjust Image: page-tool-image with img-zoom-in, img-fit, img-fill, img-reset all functional. Save (page-editor-save) returned to /preview and the saved text 'Summer in Goa' is immediately visible on the right page of the 3D book. Cover editor: preview-edit-cover-button -> /album/{id}/page?index=cover, page-tool-coverstyle -> cover-style-signature/classic/editorial all present, editorial clicked, page-editor-save returned to preview. Backend confirmed via GET /api/albums/{id}: pages[N].texts contains the text object with font/size/color/align; pages[N].images has scale/ox/oy; cover_design.style flips to 'editorial'. Design lock: POST /api/orders + POST /api/orders/pay (mock) locks album (status='ordered', locked=true) and subsequent PUT /api/albums/{id}/pages returns 409. Admin PDF: POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/pdf returns pdf_url; fetching that URL returns %PDF bytes; pages == len(pages)+1 (cover). Admin image upload: POST /api/admin/images with a JPG returns image.url that serves 200. GET /api/covers returns exactly 3 active styles (signature/classic/editorial). Regressions: OTP login, WELCOME2026 coupon (discount>0), all 4 policy endpoints (privacy/terms/refund/shipping). Zero page errors, zero red screens. One noisy console WARNING: React Native Web deprecation 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' — cosmetic-only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, but should be migrated. Grep for shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset in /app/frontend/src/**/*.tsx and consolidate into boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/app/album/[id]/page.tsx:383 canvasWrap uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset.

action_items: LOW: Migrate RN shadow* style props (canvasWrap in /app/frontend/app/album/[id]/page.tsx:383 and any other components) to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/albums.py PUT /albums/{id}/pages correctly calls _ensure_locked before saving -> returns 409 when album.status in {ordered, delivered} or locked. Verified.
backend/routers/orders.py mark_order_paid flips status='ordered' AND locked=true atomically after mock pay; also saves an 'approved' design_versions row keyed by order_id and album version. Verified.
backend/routers/admin.py POST /admin/orders/{id}/pdf uses album_snapshot (frozen at order create) so post-order edits cannot affect the print PDF — correct freeze semantics.

frontend/app/album/[id]/page.tsx PageEditor: history/redo/commit implementation is consistent; useEffect init handles isCover + initialTool='text' path. addText/duplicateText correctly bump z and clamp x/y. Save uses api.updateAlbum for cover (cover_design + style) or api.updatePages for pages — correct.

frontend/src/components/page-canvas.tsx renders both texts array and legacy page.text (fallback) — good for backward compat, but consider migrating legacy 'text' -> texts[] on auto-generate to avoid dual rendering.
COVER_STYLES in /app/frontend/src/design.ts matches backend design.py default_cover_design in style keys and frame proportions — verified via editorial round-trip.

Design version freezing: /app/backend/routers/orders.py:69 inserts kind='approved' design_versions doc at order create — matches spec. (Could not directly query design_versions via API — verified indirectly through album_snapshot in admin orders list.)

success_rate.frontend: 12/12 acceptance flows PASS (login, cover, upload, style, generate, 3D preview, dblclick page editor, text tool, layout, background, undo/redo, adjust image, save, cover editor with 3 styles)

Double-tap the right page: get preview-next parent bounding box, dblclick at (x+0.72w, y+0.5h). Backend auth endpoints are /api/auth/otp/send and /api/auth/otp/verify (not send-otp/verify-otp). Coupon endpoint is POST /api/pricing/calculate. Policy endpoint returns {policy:{body,...}} (not 'content'). PDF URL returned is relative — prepend BASE. Design-lock test uses mobile 9876500777.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs observed. All 6 iteration-7 features (style chooser, page editor, cover editor with 3 styles, design lock after payment, admin PDF from design model, admin image upload) work end-to-end in web preview and backend.
